    StartersMontana camp jerkyChewy beef jerky marinated in soy, Worcestershire and garlic, oven driedHow to make it800g beef topside4 tbsp soy sauce2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce1 tsp cracked black pepper3 cloves of garlicFreeze the beef for an hour.Slice very thin across the grain.Mix the soy, Worcestershire, pepper and crushed garlic and coat the beef.Marinate overnight.Lay on racks over trays.Dry in the oven at 75°C until chewy.Canary seed crackersCrunchy sunflower, pepita, linseed and chia crackers with soft goat cheeseHow to make it60g sunflower seeds60g pepitas60g linseeds60g sesame seeds40g chia seeds250ml water150g soft goat's cheeseMix the sunflower seeds, pepitas, linseeds, sesame seeds and chia seeds with the water.Rest for 15 minutes.Spread thin on a lined tray.Bake at 160°C until crunchy.Break into shards and serve with goat's cheese.Logogram parmesan and black sesame crispsThe circular inky logograms the heptapods writeHow to make itAs written, serves 4Parmesan and black sesame spooned into rings and baked into lacy crisps, each splattered with a little squid ink mayo like a heptapod logogram.Mix 150g finely grated parmesan with 2 tbsp black sesame seeds.Spoon into 16 thin rings about 8cm wide on baking paper, leaving the middles open.Bake at 190°C for 6 minutes until golden and lacy, then cool on the tray to crisp.Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tsp squid ink.Flick or pipe the black mayo around each crisp in a rough circle just before serving.Kangaroo skewers with pepperberryLouise's story.
